items.text: In a governing coalition, keeps in place compulsory health insurance for every resident. About 90 percent of residents are in public insurance funds that set contributions by income, give all members the same benefits, and cover family members at no extra charge.

In a governing coalition, keeps in place the existing income support, in which mandatory pension schemes replace about 53 percent of an average worker's net earnings and a single adult with no other income is guaranteed about 44 percent of the median income.

The party leader, as head of government, said the current social system is no longer affordable and that painful cuts will be needed, naming the basic income benefit and stronger incentives to work longer before drawing a pension.
